photos.file: Trochodendron aralioides - Hillier Gardens - Romsey, Hampshire, England - DSC04600.jpg
photos.desc: Horticultural specimen in Sir Harold Hillier Gardens - Romsey, Hampshire, England.
The specimen in my shady raised bed to compare with the one in the ground at Pool Meadow [1] . This one has a more orange winter speckling where the Pool Meadow plant is more maroon.
